visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair tied back, wearing a white long-sleeved sweater, sits at a wooden desk in an office environment. She holds a blue Lipton-branded popcorn bag, pointing specifically at the 3COINS logo while looking towards the camera with a curious expression. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up as she opens the plastic bag, bringing it close to her face to smell the aroma; she then retrieves a round, glazed popcorn kernel and shows it to the lens before eating it with a smile. (3) Two additional snack bags, one vibrant red and one bright yellow, are handed to her by an unseen person from the right side of the frame; she holds them up together against the desk background which includes a computer monitor and stationery. (4) The woman is then seen in a domestic kitchen and a narrow hallway, tasting the lemon and apple-flavored snacks; she points her finger and makes facial expressions comparing the three flavors. (5) The video ends with a static shot of the blue bag held in a hand, followed by a pink graphic end-screen containing social media icons and various website links.
